# Duplicate Title

## Section

Body text under a repeated name.

## Section

The second heading reducing to the same name.

## Section-2

A heading whose own words are the disambiguated form of the one above.

## 日本語の見出し

A CJK heading must still make a usable anchor.

## <ruby>今日<rt>きょう</rt></ruby>の授業

A ruby reading is apparatus, not part of the section's name.

## See [[Never Written]]

The sentence explaining an unwritten link is out of sight, and out of the name.

> [!note] A callout around a heading
> ### Inside a callout
> A heading written inside a callout, slugged in the note's one id space.
